designOrigin: Trial 27 development showed that the static literature direction had strong gross economics but both candidate and benchmark failed venue-isolated margin and 20% unilateral gap-stress gates because fixed collateral was allowed to drift across a two-year trend. Trial 28 is a new trial, frozen after that observation and before any Trial 28 economics, testing whether conservative self-financing collateral rebalancing and lower notional convert the cross-venue carry into a robust implementation. Trial 27 remains a no-go and is not altered.
hypothesis: Static long-Binance/short-Hyperliquid cross-venue funding carry can retain at least 7% annualized return after conservative execution and transfer costs while passing venue-isolated maintenance and 20% unilateral gap stress if each sleeve uses lower notional, large venue collateral buffers, weekly collateral equalization, and monthly position re-anchoring.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final market rows and economics may be observed only after every frozen development gate passes.

strategy.direction: always long Binance perpetual and short equal-coin Hyperliquid perpetual
strategy.riskOrdering: At each boundary book realized price and funding first, test maintenance and frozen unilateral gap stress before any rescue transfer, then perform scheduled collateral rebalancing; scheduled position re-anchoring closes and reopens both legs at full modeled costs.

fundingClock.binance: Use the Binance funding settlement at each exact 8h boundary.
fundingClock.hyperliquid: Use raw fundingHistory publication/settlement timestamps without backdating. For each 8h interval (previous boundary,current boundary], sum every Hyperliquid fundingRate record whose raw timestamp falls in that interval. Missing settlement means zero cash for that interval; no interpolation.
fundingClock.causality: Funding cash is booked only when actually settled/published.

costModel.application: Each leg pays fee plus slippage on every open/close/re-anchor. Each scheduled collateral rebalance pays 5 bps on gross collateral moved across the three sleeve buckets.

marginModel.rule: Fail if either venue balance is below 5% maintenance or would fall below it after an instantaneous adverse 20% move before hedge offset; the test occurs before scheduled collateral rebalancing.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 28 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, notional, collateral target, transfer cadence, re-anchor cadence, cost, clock rule, or gate may change under Trial 28.
